# Don Bosco Park Circus Website Carousel Element

This carousel, used for making the Don Bosco Park Circus Website is a simple implementation of a carousel similar to the one found on the Johns Hopkins University homepage. It uses HTML, CSS (SCSS), and JavaScript to create a sliding carousel with captions.

## Project Structure

In this folder, you shall find the following file structure - 

css/styles.css

images/dbpcfield
images/dbpcinner
images/outer

js/script.js

scss/styles.scss

index.html

readme.md

### CSS

The CSS files contain the styling of the webpage. This file is linked to the index.html file.

### Images

The three images are three different slides of the carousel and are linked to the index.html file.

The image description is as follows -

- DBPC Field - Photograph of the field of Don Bosco Park Circus Campus. [Get it here.](data:image/jpeg;base64,)

- DBPC Inner - Photograph of the inner building of Don Bosco Park Circus.

- DBPC Outer - Photograph of the outer building of Don Bosco Park Circus.
